g.text: Twelve trials per point; two graphs, one sampler. Ranges are descriptive.
Graph two reverses the full schedule; graph and order are confounded.
Lines connect measured sizes only. All 0 flagged calls retained.
All six implementations shown; no normalization or historical pooling.
